Model policy and enforcement: represent policy_level on locations, an enforcement_probability, and fine_amount; when agents visit locations with mandates, increase effective policy_signal and apply fines probabilistically to non-compliant agents to update compliance_propensity.

Include household reinforcement: within each Household, nudge member mask_attitude and mask_use toward the household shared_norms using a small learning rate each day.

Add policy feedback: compute the current overall adoption; if below target_adoption_threshold for multiple consecutive days, have PolicyMaker escalate policy_level (e.g., from recommendation to mandate) and/or increase enforcement_strength; de-escalate when adoption is high.

Track metrics during the run: (a) daily overall adoption rate; (b) time_to_target_adoption (first day adoption >= 0.7); (c) adoption_by_demographic (grouped by age bands, gender, socioeconomic_status); (d) adoption_inequality_index (e.g., coefficient of variation or Gini across SES groups); (e) media_influence_effect (difference in adoption between agents with high credible exposure vs. high misinformation exposure); (f) supply_constraints_effect (unmet demand count / attempted purchases).
